name: GeForce 8800 GTX: 20 Years of a Legend
summary:
Celebrate 20 years of a GeForce legend and rediscover the thrill of unboxing a new GPU. Created by Dylan Browne, this experience revisits 2006 with cutting-edge GeForce RTX technology.

Step into a 2006-era PC gaming room, unbox the GeForce 8800 GTX, inspect it up close, and install it in an era-accurate PC tower. Explore nods to GeForce history and hidden easter eggs as DLSS 4.5 with Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, Ray Reconstruction, path tracing, and Mega Geometry bring the nostalgic setting to life. From holding the card to the glow of the monitor, rediscover a moment in PC gaming history - or experience it for the first time!
